verdict.rationale: Local user groups or meetups are a fair ecosystem question for a UI framework like React, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack, neither the docs, the GitHub items nor the community threads, mentions a meetup directory, local user groups or in-person events a developer could find and join. A community comment praising a conference talk is not evidence of a local meetup listing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can find and join a local in-person user group or meetup for the framework
